products.name: Oxford Overshirt
products.description: A heavyweight oxford cloth overshirt built for layering. Garment-dyed for depth of color and softened from the first wear.

products.name: Relaxed Denim Jean
products.description: A straight-leg denim jean with a relaxed top block and gentle taper from the knee. Cut from 13.75oz Japanese selvedge denim.

products.name: Pique Polo
products.description: A refined take on the classic polo. Cut from organic cotton pique with a ribbed collar and two-button placket.

products.name: Wool Blend Crew
products.description: A heavyweight knit crewneck in a merino-cotton blend. Ribbed cuffs and hem, reinforced shoulder seams. Everyday warmth with an elevated hand feel.

products.name: Canvas Field Jacket
products.description: A rugged field jacket cut from waxed cotton canvas. Unlined for year-round versatility, with a full snap front and two patch pockets.

products.name: Linen Relaxed Shirt
products.description: A relaxed-fit linen shirt crafted from pre-washed European flax. Mother-of-pearl buttons, curved hem, and a camp collar.

products.name: Organic Cotton Tee
products.description: A heavy-weight organic cotton t-shirt with a relaxed fit. Rib-knit collar, taped shoulder seams, and a chest pocket.

products.name: Structured Bomber
products.description: A structured bomber jacket in waxed cotton shell. Ribbed cuffs and hem, two-way zip, and a quilted satin interior.

products.name: Cashmere Blend Scarf
products.description: A lightweight cashmere-merino blend scarf with hand-fringed edges. Generous proportions for versatile styling.

products.name: Italian Leather Belt
products.description: A full-grain Italian leather belt with a solid brass buckle. Tapered design with Chicago screw construction.

products.name: Raw Denim Jacket
products.description: A classic type-III denim jacket in unsanforized raw selvedge denim. Button front, chest pockets, and adjustable waist tabs.

products.name: Woven Silk Tie
products.description: A hand-finished woven silk tie in a classic seven-fold construction. 8cm blade width with a subtle matte finish.

products.name: Cotton Twill Cap
products.description: A structured six-panel cap in garment-washed cotton twill. Adjustable brass buckle closure and pre-curved peak.

products.name: Lambswool Scarf
products.description: A pure lambswool scarf in a classic herringbone weave. Generous length with self-tipped fringed ends.
